operations.why: Start from at most three storeys for the rear work house; the two smaller resident houses are lowered by the subsequent divisions.
Separate a rear work house from the street-side residents by a genuine ground-level gap; each side must hold rooms and an independent accessible core.
Divide the front into two smaller houses with a broad middle entrance to the common ground, rather than letting two objects touch and count as one.
Shorten and deepen the rear work house; retreat its eastern face to make one common courtyard beyond the two separate front doors.
Give the southern gathering house a simple room plan while holding back its road-facing end from the southeast service allowance.
